sloka: आयन्ती तेन दृष्टा ऽस्मि त्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम ।गृहीता तेन पृष्टा ऽस्मि कस्य त्वमिति रक्षसा ।। ७.२६.४९ ॥
transliteration: āyantī tena dṛṣṭā 'smi tvatsakāśamarindama ।gṛhītā tena pṛṣṭā 'smi kasya tvamiti rakṣasā ।। 7.26.49 ॥

translations.english: O destroyer of enemies, I was seen by him while coming to your presence, and I was seized and asked by that Rakshasa, "Whose are you?"
